title: AudioFM: Towards General Purpose Audio Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34183v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning audio representations that effectively bridge holistic global soundscapes with fine-grained acoustic moments is a long-standing goal in self-supervised learning. Recording-level contrastive objectives encourage agreement between pooled audio representations, but do not explicitly supervise local time-frequency representations. We introduce AudioFM, a self-supervised framework that combines recording-level contrast with patch-wise masked latent discrimination. Using visible acoustic context, a student predicts representations of masked patches and identifies their corresponding full-view teacher targets among candidates from other recordings. We further incorporate weaker supervision from eligible temporal neighbors to encourage local temporal consistency. translated_title: AudioFM：迈向通用音频表征学习
translated_abstract: 学习能够有效连接整体全局声景与细粒度声学时刻的音频表征，是自监督学习领域的一个长期目标。录音级别的对比目标鼓励汇聚音频表征之间的一致性，但并未对局部时频表征进行显式监督。我们提出了AudioFM，这是一个将录音级别对比与逐补丁掩码潜在判别相结合的自监督框架。利用可见的声学上下文，学生网络预测被掩码补丁的表征，并从来自其他录音的候选中识别出其对应的完整视图教师目标。我们进一步引入来自合格时间邻居的较弱监督，以促进局部时间一致性。大量评估表明，AudioFM在线性探测、微调和零样本迁移中，在多样化的音频领域均取得了最先进的性能……
tldr: AudioFM是一个自监督音频表征学习框架，通过将录音级别对比学习与逐补丁掩码潜在判别相结合，并辅以时间邻居的弱监督来促进局部时间一致性，在线性探测、微调和零样本迁移中于多个音频领域均达到了最先进的性能。
en_tdlr: AudioFM is a self-supervised framework that combines recording-level contrast with patch-wise masked latent discrimination, augmented by weak temporal-neighbor supervision, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse audio domains in linear probing, fine-tuning, and zero-shot transfer.
